_note: Read by tools/calibration_report.py for the report's 'What changed' section. Each entry names the parameters it changed as [from, to] (from null: a new parameter); the script checks each 'to' against core/data/table_params.json and lists any that no longer match. Update it with every tuning.
heading: What changed in M1's tuning from the starting values

changes.why: refitted by least squares to the published half-ball stun throw (Alciatore, Billiards Digest Sept 2006; Jewett 1995). The old fit threw 1.7 degrees on a firm cut against 3.45 measured.
Mathavan, Jackson & Parkin's measurements on a snooker table and ball (Am. J. Phys. 2009; Proc. IMechE 2010), the same source as the cushion model.
the fast end of the snooker evidence that the lag target allows (Mathavan measured 0.0127 on an unheated lab table).
pooltool's snooker cue (ball mass / 30): squirt at maximum side drops from 3.05 to 2.0 degrees, inside C9's 1-3.

the slope is a least-squares fit to Mathavan's measured rebounds above 2.5 m/s (Proc. IMechE 2010, Fig. 7b); the floor is Alciatore's typical rail restitution (TP B.6), reached at 4.25 m/s into the cushion.
